Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against the human adenosine A3 receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target name 'Adenosine A3 receptor' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Require structures via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Sort results by compound ChEMBL identifier.
